cases.name: Two keepsakes
cases.prompt: From the hill trip I have a pressed leaf and a rail ticket. I remember collecting the leaf beside the lodge.
expectations: Creates distinct leaf and ticket records.
Links both to the hill trip.
Attaches the lodge memory only to the leaf.
Leaves the ticket's origin or story unspecified.

cases.name: Missing scan
cases.prompt: My ticket is labeled scan-02. I lost the scan. I recall riding with my sister, who liked the bridge.
expectations: Uses scan-02 as a media label.
Describes the ride from the supplied recollection.
Attributes the bridge memory to the sister.
Avoids invented information from the missing scan.

cases.name: Prepare public caption
cases.prompt: Make a shareable caption for a concert stub from our city weekend. The ticket has a barcode and reservation number; I keep it in a desk drawer.
expectations: Identifies a concert stub and the city weekend.
